title: dispatch-priority — order buckets by consequence-to-objective, and escalate with the trigger recorded
description: Use when the dispatcher must order buckets and the user has not pinned that order. Priority is ordering buckets by consequence-to-objective (distinct from `product`, which sets WHAT matters), via an escalation ladder: P0 run-blocker (blocks the objective or breaks main/a shipped artifact), P1 objective-critical (serves the objective; unblocks ≥2 buckets), P2 in-scope normal, P3 deferrable (files only). Escalation targets are the roster — `product`, `architect`/`architect-decision`, `researcher`, any named specialist — not `product` alone; its purpose is twofold: in-run resolution and not relying on the user. Every escalation records its trigger in the rule-16 run line. The high/critical filter applies ONLY to a HIGH+ immediate review correction. Reach the user only when every resource and the dispatcher's authority are exceeded, or rule 12's chain-depth limits. Load when ordering buckets, when a bucket's priority changes, or when deciding whether a review finding enters this run.
author: sox
